source: 之之真实错句。49 预编 E1-E6（2026 两次模考实录 Quiet place / Museum）+ 87 自建（模考联动/手动导入）。首期聚焦错得最多的 Top3：E1 时态漂移 11 / E2 词性混淆 8 / E3 双动词缺 be 7。B 的每句 wrong 都是她真实说过的原句；A 的提问句为引导句（wrong 空 = 她没错过）。

scenes.topic: P2 去年去过的一个安静地方
scenes.goal: 把「讲过去的事滑回现在时」这个最大的毛病打死：全程 was / were / 过去式

lines.speaker: A
lines.right: Where did you go last summer?

hints.text: go [ɡəʊ] v.去；summer [ˈsʌmə] n.夏天
问过去的事：did + 主语 + 动词原形

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: The place was in Xiamen.
lines.fix: P2 讲去年 → was，不是 is；别把 was 整个漏掉

hints.text: was [wɒz] v.是（过去式）；place [pleɪs] n.地方
P2 全程过去时：讲去年就用 was / were

lines.speaker: A
lines.right: What was it like there?

hints.text: like [laɪk] prep.像…样；there [ðeə] adv.那里
问过去的感受：What was it like...?

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: So it was very quiet.
lines.fix: 过去叙事 → was，不是 is

hints.text: quiet [ˈkwaɪət] adj.安静的
过去 → it was，不是 it is

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: There was almost no one there.
lines.fix: 缺 there be → There was almost no one there

hints.text: almost [ˈɔːlməʊst] adv.几乎；no one 没有人
「那儿有…」= There was / There were，不能省

fills: The place was in Hangzhou
The place was near the sea
The place was in a small town
So it was very noisy
So it was very crowded
So it was very peaceful

variants.pattern: There was/were almost no X there
fills: There were almost no cars there
There was almost no noise there
There were almost no people there

scenes.topic: P2 和家人在一起的一天
scenes.goal: 过去叙事里每一句都要过去式：wanted / let me go / walked，别滑回现在时

lines.speaker: A
lines.right: Why did you go there?

hints.text: why [waɪ] adv.为什么
问过去的原因：Why did + 主语 + 原形

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: Because we were very tired.
lines.fix: 觉得很累 = we were tired，不是 think tired

hints.text: tired [ˈtaɪəd] adj.累的；because [bɪˈkɒz] conj.因为
「觉得累」= be tired，不用 think；过去用 were

lines.speaker: B
lines.cn: 我爸妈想让我放松一下。
lines.right: My parents just wanted me to relax.
lines.wrong: My parents just want me to relax.
lines.fix: 过去叙事 → wanted，不是 want

hints.text: want [wɒnt] v.想要；relax [rɪˈlæks] v.放松
讲那次的事 → wanted，不是 want

lines.speaker: B
lines.cn: 他们让我去一个博物馆。
lines.right: They let me go to a museum.
lines.wrong: They let me to go a museum.
lines.fix: let sb do（不加 to）+ go TO a museum

hints.text: let [let] v.让；museum [mjuˈziːəm] n.博物馆
let sb do sth：let 后面直接加动词原形，不加 to

lines.speaker: B
lines.cn: 我一直跟在我爸妈后面走。
lines.right: I walked around with my parents.
lines.wrong: I walk around my parents all the time.
lines.fix: 过去 → walked；跟着走 = walk around with sb

hints.text: walk [wɔːk] v.走；around [əˈraʊnd] prep.围绕
过去 → walked；「和某人一起走」= walk around with sb

fills: Because we were very busy
Because we were very bored
Because we were very stressed

variants.pattern: My parents wanted me to X
fills: My parents wanted me to rest
My parents wanted me to study
My parents wanted me to come home

variants.pattern: They let me go to X
fills: They let me go to a park
They let me go to a cafe
They let me go to the library
I walked around with my friends
I walked around with my sister
I walked around with my classmates

scenes.topic: P1 好老师应该是什么样的
scenes.goal: 中文不分词性，英语要：并列必须同词性；feel / makes 后面跟形容词不是动词

lines.speaker: A
lines.cn: 你觉得什么样的老师是好老师？
lines.right: What makes a good teacher?

hints.text: make [meɪk] v.使得；teacher [ˈtiːtʃə] n.老师
What makes + 名词？= 什么造就了…

lines.speaker: B
lines.cn: 好老师要细心、乐于助人、有耐心。
lines.right: They should be careful, helpful and patient.
lines.fix: 三个并列都用形容词：careful / helpful / patient

hints.text: careful [ˈkeəfl] adj.细心的；patient [ˈpeɪʃnt] adj.有耐心的
and 并列要同词性：三个都用形容词，别混进名词

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: Teachers are very important for society.
lines.wrong: Teacher is very important for this social.
lines.fix: 泛指用复数 Teachers；社会 = society（名词），不是 social（形容词）

hints.text: society [səˈsaɪəti] n.社会；important [ɪmˈpɔːtnt] adj.重要的
泛指一类人用复数 Teachers；「社会」是名词 society，不是 social

lines.speaker: B
lines.cn: 它让我觉得很有成就感。
lines.right: It makes me feel successful.
lines.wrong: It is makes me felt successful.
lines.fix: 双动词：去掉 is；makes me feel + 原形

hints.text: successful [səkˈsesfl] adj.成功的；feel [fiːl] v.感觉
一个句子一个谓语：已有 makes，就不要 is

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: A clean room makes you more relaxed.
lines.wrong: A clean room made you more relax.
lines.fix: 放松的 = relaxed（形容词），不是 relax（动词）
lines.note: 原句 E2-2 是片段「（干净的房间）让你更放松 / ...makes you more relaxed.」，为做成完整对话句补全主语为 A clean room；错误模式保留原样（relax 当形容词 + made 时态）。

hints.text: relaxed [rɪˈlækst] adj.放松的；clean [kliːn] adj.干净的
make sb + 形容词：放松的用 relaxed，relax 是动词

variants.pattern: They should be X, Y and Z（都用形容词）
fills: They should be kind, patient and funny
They should be strict, fair and helpful

variants.pattern: It makes me feel X（形容词）
fills: It makes me feel relaxed
It makes me feel happy
It makes me feel proud

variants.pattern: A X makes you more Y（形容词）
fills: A tidy room makes you more comfortable
A quiet room makes you more relaxed
A clean desk makes you more focused

scenes.topic: P1 空闲时间与我的房间
scenes.goal: 一个句子只能有一个谓语动词：补上 be、去掉多余的 is、否定向 do 借力

lines.speaker: A
lines.right: What do you like to do in your free time?

hints.text: free time 空闲时间；like [laɪk] v.喜欢
What do you like to do...? 一般现在时问爱好

lines.speaker: B
lines.cn: 我很喜欢尝试不同的餐厅。
lines.right: I'm really into trying different restaurants.
lines.wrong: I really into trying some different restaurant.
lines.fix: 缺 be：I'm really into；restaurants 用复数

hints.text: into [ˈɪntə] prep.热衷于；restaurant [ˈrestrɒnt] n.餐厅
be into doing：缺了 be 就不是句子，要说 I'm really into

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: I always make my room a little dirty.
lines.wrong: I always made my room is a little dirty.
lines.fix: make + 宾语 + 形容词，中间不加 is（一个句子一个谓语）

hints.text: dirty [ˈdɜːti] adj.脏的；always [ˈɔːlweɪz] adv.总是
make + 宾语 + 形容词：已经有 make 当谓语，别再加 is

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: I find it hard to keep my room tidy.
lines.wrong: I often hard to keep my room tidy.
lines.fix: 「做某事难」= I find it hard to do，不是 I ... hard to do

hints.text: find [faɪnd] v.发现/觉得；tidy [ˈtaɪdi] adj.整洁的
「做…很难」= I find it hard to do sth，不能说 I ... hard to

lines.speaker: B
lines.right: Young people don't understand it.
lines.fix: 否定要借 don't，不能直接 not + 动词

hints.text: understand [ˌʌndəˈstænd] v.理解；young [jʌŋ] adj.年轻的
否定句要借 don't / doesn't，不能把 not 直接放动词前

fills: I'm really into cooking
I'm really into taking photos
I'm really into playing games
I always make my desk a little messy
I always make my room a little untidy
I always make my bed in the morning

variants.pattern: I find it hard to X
fills: I find it hard to get up early
I find it hard to focus for a long time
I find it hard to start working
